description: Takes a picture of a person and an audio file, and generates a video of THAT person speaking or singing the audio, lip-synced. Returns the new job's id immediately. The result is exactly as long as the audio. WHEN: the user wants a talking avatar, a presenter, a voiceover put on a face, or a portrait to say something. The picture supplies the person; the audio supplies both the performance AND the length. The audio must be a `generate_audio` result on this account - pass the id that tool returned, or its url. An external audio url cannot be used here yet, so if the user has audio elsewhere, the way in is to make it with `generate_audio` first. THE CARD: this call has ALREADY put the aicut card in front of the user, and it fills in the finished media on its own. Do NOT call `show_generation` for this job - that adds a duplicate card; it is only for bringing back an EARLIER generation. HOW TO WAIT: call `wait_for_generation` with this job's id and `media` - it waits server-side and opens no card. While it answers `terminal: false`, wait `poll_after_seconds` and call it again; when `terminal: true`, tell the user in ONE short line what came out. Do not poll `get_video` / `get_image` / `get_audio` instead or spawn timers, and do NOT tell the user the generation is running in between. IF YOU CANNOT RENDER AN AICUT CARD (a terminal or plain SDK client), give the user the `url` from the wait result - aicut cannot see which clients render cards. TIMING: a video usually finishes in 1-3 minutes, and can take up to about 6. Do not assume it failed before then, and do not spawn timers or background shells to wait: call `wait_for_generation` (it waits server-side for up to 15 seconds per call), wait its `poll_after_seconds` and call it again, and stop when it answers `terminal: true`. `get_video` is a single immediate read for one job's raw fields - it is not the waiting loop and must not be polled in one. COST: this spends the user's tokens, and the price is the AUDIO's length times a per-second rate that depends on the resolution - so a two-minute voiceover costs many times a ten-second one, and 1080p costs twice 720p. The audio's length is MEASURED BY THE SERVER from the file itself, never taken from anything you say - that measurement, rounded UP to the next whole second, is the price and the charge. Audio the server cannot measure is REFUSED with nothing charged. There is deliberately no length argument on this tool. Pass `estimate_only: true` first to get the exact price. An EXTERNAL url is downloaded and stored on the account before it can be measured, which uses one of the account's daily media-ingest slots. Quoting and then creating from the SAME url costs that once, not twice - aicut reuses what it already imported - and a url already on the account costs nothing at all. SPENDS TOKENS: quote it first (`estimate_only: true`), state the price IN THE SAME MESSAGE as your ask, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase - a bare 'yes' counts only as the direct answer to that priced ask, and an ambiguous one means ask again. The full SPENDING RULES in this server's instructions apply here. IF THE USER REPORTS A CHARGE OR STEP THEY DID NOT EXPECT: re-read your own tool calls and say which you made; aicut cards cannot spend (full rule in this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: `idempotency_key` is optional. Reusing a key REPLAYS the job it first created (even with different settings), so never reuse one to make another generation; the full rules are in this server's instructions (IDEMPOTENCY). OUTPUT: JSON for you to read. Tell the user the media URL plus a one-line summary; do not paste raw JSON, job ids or internal field names.

character_image.description: URL of the picture of the person who should speak. A clear, front-facing portrait works best. Either a URL an earlier generation or upload on THIS account returned, or a genuinely external public https URL - aicut downloads it, size-caps it and stores it on the account first. An aicut-hosted URL belonging to a DIFFERENT account is refused.

estimate_only.description: Price these exact settings and create nothing. Returns the token cost, the account balance, and whether the balance covers it. Costs nothing and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Read the IDEMPOTENCY note in this tool's description before using one - a reused key returns the first job instead of making a new one.

prompt.description: Optional direction for the performance - a mood or a manner. It does NOT change what is said: the words come entirely from the audio.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 1080p costs exactly twice 720p per second of audio, so ask rather than assuming. Never set this to save the user tokens or to make a generation cheaper - set it only when the user explicitly asked for this value, and never carry it over from an earlier request.

source_audio.description: The audio to lip-sync to, as either the id `generate_audio` returned or the url it produced. It must be audio generated on THIS account - make it with `generate_audio` first if the user has not. An external audio url is not accepted here yet, and neither is a local file.

name: generate_lipsync
title: Make a picture of a person speak your audio
